claims: A revised geometric manuscript of the proof that the known packing of eleven unit squares is optimal (T-060's claim, s(11) attained by the known packing), paper/eleven-squares-synthesis.tex, 'Eleven squares: owners, support chains, and angle penalties': a marker-based global reduction, a support-chain inequality for independently rotating tilted squares, an early corridor and two virtual supports that leave a 103-node dependency graph (down from 119), simplified exclusions of ownership cases 0 (an elementary terminal argument), 3 (12 point assertions instead of 62) and 5 (65 instead of 170), and quantitative nonoverlap penalties replacing the late fine capture and local-isolation endpoint (paper/README.md, README.md)
A companion, paper/eleven-squares-geometric-foundations.tex, with direct proofs of the rectangle, triangle, wall and ownership rules (paper/README.md)

A self-contained verification supplement, paper/eleven-squares-publication.zip, run by verify.py --check-inputs, --quick, --ownership, --early and --full under CPython 3.12.4's standard library; the author reports input verification, all 13 quick checks, the ownership replay and the early component replay passing in a clean extraction, and the portable full command not yet executed end to end (paper/README.md)
